A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, while NLMs have reduced perplexity significantly, their energy usage and inference latency have increased by orders of magnitude.
, in order to achieve the same level of perplexity as a state-of-the-art KN LM, a NLM must be 100x slower on the Raspberry Pi, 10x slower on the laptop, and only 1.5x slower on the desktop.
, in the case of mobile devices, the benefits of NLMs are not as clear as they are in the case of desktops.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NLMs are more expensive than KN LMs in terms energy usage, inference latency, and model size.
, while NLMs are clearly the way forward in the long term, there is still a need to develop techniques that can deliver the performance required for real-life applications.
